默认自动记录最近五分钟的性能指标。卡顿恢复后复制简短摘要反馈，需要深入排查时导出: The last five minutes of performance metrics are recorded by default. Copy a short summary after a slowdown, or export the complete JSON file for deeper investigation.
仅本地记录数值和进程角色，不记录对话、代码、文件路径、命令参数或凭据，不会自动上: Numeric metrics and process roles stay local. No conversations, code, file paths, command arguments or credentials are recorded. Nothing is uploaded automatically.

Process CPU uses one core as 100%; system CPU uses the whole machine as 100%. WebKit candidates may belong to other apps and are not GPU utilization.

经由 Cloudflare Worker 中转实现外网访问。填 Cloudfla:
Outbound access runs through your own Cloudflare Worker. Paste a Cloudflare API Token to deploy in one click — the Worker, its Durable Object and the relay key are created in your account.
The Edit Cloudflare Workers token template is enough. It is used once, is never stored (the field is cleared as soon as the deploy succeeds), and a short TTL — a day, say — is recommended so you can delete it in the dashboard right after.
Tokens starting with cfat_ are account-owned (Manage Account → Account API Tokens): Cloudflare does not let them list accounts, so fill in the Account ID too (copy it from the dashboard sidebar). A user token (My Profile → API Tokens) can leave it blank — the app reads the account by itself.
You can also click Source for the full deploy pack (source, wrangler config and a how-to) and deploy it yourself.
The relay URL and key below stay editable: if *.workers.dev is unreachable where you are, bind a custom domain and enter it there.
